description:
Echos of Gaia adds screen reader speech, Story and navigation categories, spoken route legs, optional automatic walking, region and vehicle tracking, world-map footsteps, and positional NPC/interactable/exit sounds using Steam Audio HRTF. The accessible Memoria launcher includes speech testing and settings. Native controls and player Confirm remain under the player's control.

608 personal-voice recordings describe all 42 reviewed original FMVs, generic visible field actions and 112 additional Disc 1 actions. Field narration is selective: some coordinated actions, props and optional scenes remain gaps. Complete Disc 1 coverage, a complete playthrough, physical controller coverage and all-cue in-game listening/synchronization remain unverified.

Hotkeys: U/O categories; K/semicolon targets; L status; I guidance; P automatic travel on/off; R repeat; Shift+I/Shift+P guidance interval. Hold either L2/LT or R2/RT for controller navigation: D-pad left/right categories, up/down targets, L3 spoken guidance, R3 automatic travel, Circle/B stop. Release the trigger after choosing. Standalone stick clicks no longer open a navigation menu. A trigger mapped to a core game action keeps that action; use the other trigger or keyboard navigation. The launcher labels the retained R3/L3 minigame shortcut as Hot and Cold status. Hot and Cold reads the shown timer, cries, depth and results.

Windows 10/11 64-bit; Steam app 377840 build 5378074. Both x86 and x64 game builds are included with matching Memoria support. Microsoft .NET Framework 4.8+ and Visual C++ v14 x86/x64 runtimes are declared prerequisites. Close FFIX and its launcher before installing or updating. Start the screen reader before launching through Steam. Use Load for a manual save: Continue uses the automatic checkpoint.

The manager handles file backups, updates and uninstall. Saves, existing preferences, original Unity executables, movies and unrelated mod folders stay outside the replacement list. Mods replacing the same managed assemblies need compatibility testing. Modified FMVs can fail original-footage narration checks. Use Echos releases to update this engine; its stock Memoria updater is disabled.

Source, full controls, coverage and credits: https://github.com/buu420/echos-of-gaia
Based on BlindGuyNW's accessible Memoria fork and the Memoria community engine. Maintained by buu420. Current public beta: 0.1.1. Improved ordinary Triangle/Y menu speech reads shown selections and character details, with recovery after temporary speech failures.

defaultPreInstall.what: Check the supported Steam game files, closed-game state, complete package hashes and native dependencies.
defaultPreInstall.why: Prevent an incomplete or mismatched engine installation. All game-file replacements and backups belong to the manager.
defaultPreInstall.modifies: No files, settings, registry values or gameplay state. Reads the chosen game folder and verified staging package.
